messages:
ryan: hi team, accepted the org invite but when I try to open private repos it shows 'Access denied' and Actions won't let me re-run jobs (403).
ryan: the invite email link said 'Click to authorize SSO' but after clicking it just goes to a GitHub page that says 'pending authorization'.
it-bot: heads up: Redwood requires you to authorize SSO for our identity provider after accepting the invite. See onboarding guide: https://redwood.dev/onboard/github
devx-ana: @ryan can you confirm which GitHub account you used and whether you clicked the "Authorize SSO" button on the org page?
ryan: used ryan.dev@gmail.com, clicked the authorize button, then GitHub asked to redirect to our IdP and I got a spinner then returned to GitHub with 'pending authorization'.
idp-admin: that usually means the SAML session didn't complete — often a browser cookie or popup blocker issue. Quick checks: try in an incognito window, or allow popups for github.com, and make sure you're logged into the correct IdP account (ryan@contractor.com vs ryan@redwood.ai).
ryan: i'm logged into okta as ryan@redwood.ai in another tab. tried incognito, same result. still 'pending authorization'.
idp-admin: hmm — can you open developer tools network tab and see if the SAML POST returned a 200? if not, paste any error here.
ryan: not sure how to read that. i see a 403 to `https://idp.redwood.ai/sso/authorize` with body 'assertion not valid'.
idp-admin: thanks. that indicates your GitHub account email doesn't match the IdP attribute used for SAML (we send 'mail' which must equal verified work email on GH). Do you have ryan@redwood.ai added to your GitHub account?
ryan: i didn't add the work email, i only have the personal gmail. i thought SSO would map by username.
devx-ana: GitHub SAML requires the IdP email/attribute match a verified email on the GitHub account. Easiest fix: add ryan@redwood.ai to Settings -> Emails, verify it, then retry the Authorize SSO flow.
idp-admin: i'll hold off on re-sending invites until you verify the email. once you do, ping here and i can trigger a forced mapping sync and authorize you on the org side.
ryan: added and verified ryan@redwood.ai. retried authorize flow and it completed. now the org page shows my membership and teams pending.
idp-admin: running manual SSO sync + granting temporary repo write for CI rerun.
idp-admin: sync complete. invited you into teams: eng, infra; temporary write granted on repo "service-core" so you can re-run Actions.
ryan: re-ran the workflow and it succeeded! can now see private repos. thanks so much.
devx-ana: welcome! if you have any old PRs under the personal account we can keep them intact by mapping that account (add the work email there) or transfer branches — LMK what you prefer.
it-bot: reminder: always verify your work email on GitHub before authorizing SSO to avoid the pending state. Docs: https://redwood.dev/onboard/github#sso
ryan: will add a short intro to #new-hires-intros, and i'll follow up about consolidating a couple of forks. really appreciate the help :raised_hands:
